secondary_discovery_source.page_claim: The third-party profile labels the Neshoba MRF as updated 2026-09-01 and links a raw-file download.
secondary_discovery_source.source_role: secondary discovery lead only; not publisher metadata or CCN scope authority

finding: The secondary profile's 2026-09-01 label is not corroborated by the file it links: the downloaded object is byte-identical to the already-retained PARA MRF, whose own last_updated_on remains 2026-06-04. This is a third-party date/label discrepancy, not a new September MRF and not a publisher-confirmed file update.
ccn_scope: The file names the shared Neshoba campus but no CCN. CMS currently lists same-campus acute-care 250043 and critical-access 251340; QIES POS separately records 250043 termination date 2025-12-31 and 251340 active/original participation 2026-01-01. This retrieval does not resolve the discrepancy among those CMS records or assign the file to either CCN.
disposition_effect: none; retain both CCN records and the existing shared-campus uncertainty
next_action: Use the exact dated CMS QIES status history and obtain publisher confirmation or current pointer bytes naming the CCN scope; do not infer a September file version from the secondary profile label, and do not assign the shared MRF to either CCN until the dual-record scope is resolved.
